definitions.explanation: The room in a hospital where surgery is performed. The red light above its door, {手術中|しゅじゅつちゅう}, is a familiar image from TV dramas.

examples.japanese: {手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: To go into the operating room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧、{手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My father is in the operating room now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{終|お}わる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: The family waited for hours outside the operating room for the surgery to end.

notes:
⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧ (surgery) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). With しゅ, じゅ and つし close together, the reading is a classic tongue twister for learners and native speakers alike: しゅじゅつしつ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれる→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to be taken into the operating room
- {手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧: to wait outside the operating room
- {手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧: to come out of the operating room

- ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧: surgery
- ⟦{病室|びょうしつ}→病室：21074_byoushitsu⟧: hospital room (for patients)
